NBA Street V3.name: NBA Street V3
NBA Street V3.summary: The GameCube version features Mario, Luigi, and Princess Peach as playable characters, collectively known in-game as the "Nintendo All-Stars". This is in response to a deal between EA and Nintendo in which EA would include Nintendo characters and properties in a few of their games; another game to take advantage of this was SSX Tour. A basketball court based on the Mario franchise, named the Nintendo Court, is also featured in the GameCube version.
